business_requirement: Every second Tuesday of each month at 2pm
impact_description: Outlook legacy parsers ignore BYSETPOS when FREQ=MONTHLY without daily intervals; 2TU is universally supported.
RFC 5545 Section 3.8.5.3 explicitly mandates UTC 'Z' for UNTIL timestamps; local formats cause Google Calendar reject.
Without explicit EXDATE participants receive meeting alerts on national office holidays.
If DTSTART falls on an off-week the alternating sequence inverts across fiscal quarter boundaries.
Generative models often write BYDAY=FR;BYSETPOS=-1 which causes Apple Calendar sync stalls.
